answer: The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in mirror, expire in inlet, and pigment lists each expiry. An adversary running 124 aliases therefore needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3530 identities would post 3034 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
